thread:
maria: Quick brainstorm: Sparkline feature launch — want to run a tight PLG experiment tied to a short demo and social push. proposal: 150 starter credits + "starter prompt kit" for participants. micro-webinar (20m) to demo templates. measure 3d retention + time-to-first-success. thoughts? :sparkles:

leo: love the micro format. can we also test incentivized vs non-incentivized replay gating? e.g., replay unlocked only after claim vs open replay freely. helps understand credit friction.

jamal: +1. cohort split idea: A) credits only, B) credits + promptkit, C) credits + promptkit + 3-step nudge drip. target 2.4k signups (800/arm). region: global but block APAC late hours.

katherine: for inbox routing: inbound signups -> tag as sparkline_experiment, then route heavy-workspace signals to sales if >10 seats. Growth wants to test auto-highlighting use-case in followup for marketing vs sales.

maria: ok routing sounds good. add a funnel flag so support gets early heads-up for credit redemptions. jamal can you confirm tracking?

jamal: will add `experiment_id=sparkline_q1_v2`, `arms=[ctrl_credits, prompts, prompts_nudge]`. tracking spec:
```
utm_campaign=sparkline_q1
experiment_tag=sparkline_q1_v2
event=promptkit_installed
event=credit_redeemed
```
I'll also make a cohort for time-based attribution window: 14d for paid-conversion.

leo: creative needs: 1) launch social carousel, 2) 30s demo clip for webinar ad, 3) replay landing hero. message hypothesis for benchmarks doc: "Prompt kit shortens time-to-first-success by >40%" and "Nudge series raises 3d retention by 10ppt."

maria: benchmark narrative: we'll baseline last quarter's similar micro-launch: average time-to-first-success = 2.1 days, 3d retention = 18%. set guardrail for rollout: if 3d retention drops below 12% cancel nudge. i'll add to brief: https://redwood.company/s/sparkline-brief

katherine: webinar plan: Tue 11am PT, 20min (10min demo, 7min templates walkthrough, 3min Q&A). collect workspace size + primary use-case on signup and include checkbox "claim credits" (pre-checked for experiment arms). replay gating: variant test per leo.

ops-bot: scheduled webinar "Sparkline: ship features faster" for 2025-04-15T18:00:00Z. reminder emails set: 48h, 2h, 10m before. :white_check_mark:

maria: nudges cadence suggestion: Day0 email with promptkit + quickstart, Day1 in-app checklist, Day2 contextual tip, Day4 reward email (50 extra credits) if 2 demos completed. keep opt-out.

jamal: measurement: primary = time_to_first_success_median (hours), secondary = 3d_retention_pct, tertiary = 14d_paid_conv_rate. will instrument quickstart success event `quickstart.success`.

leo: run small creative A/B: headline variant A "Ship features with ready prompts" vs B "Build with Sparkline templates" — want to surface which resonates in CTR.

katherine: inbound routing note: paid-intent leads (workspace size > 20 OR >5 seats claimed) -> sales queue; otherwise -> nurture email track. add tag `sparkline_paid_intent`.

maria: one more ask: include a short benchmark blurb for public launch post so we can quote internal numbers later. e.g., "In early tests, teams reached first success 40% faster with Sparkline templates." only publish after results.

jamal: scheduling: experiment kick at Tue 09:00 PT, creative freeze Mon 18:00 PT. i'll push tracking PR today and notify analytics.

leo: i'll queue social creative and upload to drive. ping when growth-bot has cohort ready.

growth-bot: experiment `sparkline_q1_v2` created, cohorts seeded (800/arm), rollout window set 2025-04-15T09:00:00Z -> 2025-04-22T09:00:00Z. Attribution tags added.

maria: perfect. next steps: leo -> creative upload by Mon EOD, jamal -> tracking PR + cohort config, katherine -> routing rules in CRM, i'll draft webinar outline and benchmark doc. follow-up sync Wed 10am PT. thanks team! :rocket:
